read.en: Zscaler fell 0.6% on Nov 11 to $193.79, trading $193.09–203.00. It is below the 5-day ($197.9), 10-day ($214.8) and 30-day ($221.8) and above the rising 100-day ($183.4) and the 200-day ($166.7). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($241.6), and RSI is 36.2.

read.en: No level changed: the $203 high stopped at the $201.6–203 resistance, the close stayed under $195.1–195.8, and the $193.09 low held above the $187.5–188.9 September lows. Resistance is $195.1–197.9 (Sep 29 and Oct 2 lows, Nov 9 low, 5-day), then $201.6–203 and $210.5–214.8 (Nov 6 high, 10-day). Support is $187.5–188.9, then $183.4 (100-day) and $166.7 (200-day). A close above $197.9 would target $202–203; below $187.5, $183.4.
